Could this be FT_IPv4 or FT_IPv6?

Per this doc: https://www.etsi.org/deliver/etsi_ts/129300_129399/129338/15.03.00_60/ts_129338v150300p.pdf
Page 43 / Table 6.2.3.1-1 :

This IE shall contain the E.164 number of the SMS-GMSC (or SMS
Router) previously received in the SMS-GMSC Address IE in the MT
Forward Short Message Request

so this is not an IP Address.
Is this a list, or a single message?
This is a subtemplate ID and it's a list of messages.
Right, but the label+filter are singular, whereas the blurb is plural.
